text: The purpose of this report is to present the updated 2018 audited financial results for The Board of Directors of the Hummingbird Centre for the Performing Arts (operating as TO Live).

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approved the 2018 Audited Financial Results in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 9, 2020) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 2. Authorized the public release of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 9, 2020) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live, once adopted by the Board and finalized and signed by PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP. Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 9, 2020) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live is now public and can be accessed under Background Information.
